name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad
overview: 2026年，Tenaga Nasional Berhad 通过其全资子公司 TNB Renewables 与 Luminous Aspect 及 CSP 500MW 签署合资协议，共同开发一个500MWac太阳能光伏项目并配套250MW/1,000MWh电池储能系统，TNB Renewables 持股70%。同时，集团继续进行内部整合，对两家休眠子公司 TNB Properties 和 TNP Construction 进行成员自愿清盘。
overview_en: In 2026, Tenaga Nasional Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary TNB Renewables, signed a joint venture shareholders' agreement with Luminous Aspect and CSP 500MW to develop a 500MWac solar photovoltaic project with a 250MW/1,000MWh battery energy storage system, with TNB Renewables holding a 70% stake. Meanwhile, the group continued internal rationalisation by placing two dormant subsidiaries, TNB Properties and TNP Construction, into members' voluntary winding-up.

segments.name: 发电
segments.note: 通过合资方式拓展可再生能源发电，开发大型太阳能光伏及电池储能项目。
segments.note_en: Expanding renewable generation through a joint venture to develop a large-scale solar PV and battery storage project.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 TNB Renewables 与 Luminous Aspect 及 CSP 500MW 签署合资股东协议，共同开发500MWac太阳能光伏项目及250MW/1,000MWh电池储能系统，TNB Renewables 持股70%。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary TNB Renewables signed a joint venture shareholders' agreement with Luminous Aspect and CSP 500MW to develop a 500MWac solar PV project with a 250MW/1,000MWh battery energy storage system, with TNB Renewables holding a 70% stake.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 对休眠子公司进行自愿清盘，作为集团内部整合的一部分。
segments.note_en: Placing dormant subsidiaries into voluntary winding-up as part of group rationalisation.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 TNB Properties Sdn. Bhd.（休眠的物业管理公司）进行成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary TNB Properties Sdn. Bhd. (a dormant property management company) was placed into members' voluntary winding-up.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 TNP Construction Sdn. Bhd.（休眠的建筑承包商）进行成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary TNP Construction Sdn. Bhd. (a dormant construction contractor) was placed into members' voluntary winding-up.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过合资公司 Bahau Energy Ventures Sdn. Bhd. 进入企业可再生能源供应计划下的太阳能光伏及电池储能开发业务。
model_changes.text_en: Entered the solar PV and battery energy storage development business under the Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme through the joint venture company Bahau Energy Ventures Sdn. Bhd.
